CREATE TRIGGER trg_runs_meeting_task_update before update of task_id,job_id on runs when new.record_type='meeting_alignment_runs' and (exists(select 1 from tasks where id=new.task_id and (record_type<>'meeting_alignment_jobs' or new.job_id is not null)) or (not exists(select 1 from tasks where id=new.task_id) and new.job_id is null)) begin select raise(abort,'meeting run parent mapping mismatch'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_runs_record_type_immutable before update of record_type on runs when new.record_type<>old.record_type begin select raise(abort,'run record type is immutable'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_runs_reply_task_insert before insert on runs when new.record_type='agent_runs' and new.task_id is not null and exists(select 1 from tasks where id=new.task_id and record_type<>'reply_tasks') begin select raise(abort,'run task must be a reply task'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_runs_reply_task_update before update of task_id on runs when new.record_type='agent_runs' and new.task_id is not null and exists(select 1 from tasks where id=new.task_id and record_type<>'reply_tasks') begin select raise(abort,'run task must be a reply task'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_runtime_attempt_generalized_lease_insert before insert on runs when new.record_type='agent_runtime_attempts' and (new.parent_id is null and new.status in ('starting','running') and (trim(new.lease_owner)='' or trim(new.lease_expires_at)='')) begin select raise(abort,'active generalized attempt requires lease'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_runtime_attempt_generalized_lease_update before update of status, lease_owner, lease_expires_at on runs when new.record_type='agent_runtime_attempts' and (new.parent_id is null and new.status in ('starting','running') and (trim(new.lease_owner)='' or trim(new.lease_expires_at)='')) begin select raise(abort,'active generalized attempt requires lease'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_runtime_attempt_lineage_immutable before update of attempt_purpose,validation_retry_policy_id,validation_result_schema_id on runs when new.record_type='agent_runtime_attempts' and (new.attempt_purpose<>old.attempt_purpose or new.validation_retry_policy_id<>old.validation_retry_policy_id or new.validation_result_schema_id<>old.validation_result_schema_id) begin select raise(abort,'runtime attempt correction lineage is immutable'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_runtime_attempt_lineage_insert before insert on runs when new.record_type='agent_runtime_attempts' and (new.attempt_purpose not in ('normal','result_validation_correction') or (new.attempt_purpose='normal' and (new.validation_retry_policy_id<>'' or new.validation_result_schema_id<>'')) or (new.attempt_purpose='result_validation_correction' and (trim(new.validation_retry_policy_id)='' or trim(new.validation_result_schema_id)=''))) begin select raise(abort,'invalid runtime attempt correction lineage'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_runtime_attempt_lineage_update before update of attempt_purpose, validation_retry_policy_id, validation_result_schema_id on runs when new.record_type='agent_runtime_attempts' and (new.attempt_purpose not in ('normal','result_validation_correction') or (new.attempt_purpose='normal' and (new.validation_retry_policy_id<>'' or new.validation_result_schema_id<>'')) or (new.attempt_purpose='result_validation_correction' and (trim(new.validation_retry_policy_id)='' or trim(new.validation_result_schema_id)=''))) begin select raise(abort,'invalid runtime attempt correction lineage'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_runtime_attempt_session_evidence_trim_insert before insert on runs when new.record_type='agent_runtime_attempts' and (new.session_mode is null or new.source_session_id is null or not ((new.session_mode='fresh' and new.source_session_id='') or (new.session_mode='resume' and trim(new.source_session_id)<>''))) begin select raise(abort,'invalid runtime attempt session evidence'); end

CREATE TRIGGER trg_runtime_attempt_session_evidence_trim_update before update of session_mode, source_session_id on runs when new.record_type='agent_runtime_attempts' and (new.session_mode is null or new.source_session_id is null or not ((new.session_mode='fresh' and new.source_session_id='') or (new.session_mode='resume' and trim(new.source_session_id)<>''))) begin select raise(abort,'invalid runtime attempt session evidence'); end

CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_task_runs_claim
                    on scheduled_task_runs(dispatch_status, scheduled_for, id)

CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_task_runs_dispatch
                    on scheduled_task_runs(
                        dispatch_status, lease_expires_at, scheduled_for, id
                    )

CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_task_runs_latest
                    on scheduled_task_runs(scheduled_task_id, id desc)

CREATE INDEX idx_scheduled_task_runs_reply_execution
                    on scheduled_task_runs(
                        cast(execution_id as integer), scheduled_task_id, id
                    )
                    where execution_kind='reply_task'

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_scheduled_task_runs_scheduled_instant
                    on scheduled_task_runs(scheduled_task_id, scheduled_for)
                    where trigger_kind = 'scheduled'

CREATE TABLE scheduled_task_runs (
                    id integer primary key autoincrement,
                    event_id text not null unique,
                    scheduled_task_id integer not null,
                    trigger_kind text not null check(trigger_kind in (
                        'scheduled', 'manual'
                    )),
                    scheduled_for text not null,
                    dispatch_status text not null default 'pending' check(
                        dispatch_status in (
                            'pending', 'dispatched', 'skipped', 'failed'
                        )
                    ),
                    skip_or_error_reason text not null default '',
                    execution_kind text not null default '',
                    execution_id text not null default '',
                    lease_owner text not null default '',
                    lease_expires_at text,
                    created_at text not null default current_timestamp,
                    dispatched_at text, first_scheduled_for text not null default '', occurrence_count integer not null default 1, result_summary text not null default '', snapshot_id integer references scheduled_task_config_versions(id),
                    foreign key(scheduled_task_id) references scheduled_tasks(id)
                )
CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_tasks_updated_id on workbench_tasks(updated_at, id)

CREATE TABLE workbench_tasks (
                    id text primary key,
                    title text not null,
                    runtime_kind text not null,
                    provider_session_ref text not null default '',
                    archived_at text not null default '',
                    created_at text not null default current_timestamp,
                    updated_at text not null default current_timestamp
                )

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_workbench_one_active_turn
                    on workbench_turns(task_id)
                    where status in ('queued', 'running', 'waiting_confirmation')

CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_turns_queue
                    on workbench_turns(status, created_at, id)

CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_turns_recovery
                    on workbench_turns(status, lease_expires_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_turns_task_created_id on workbench_turns(task_id, created_at, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_workbench_turns_task_sequence on workbench_turns(task_id, task_sequence desc)

CREATE TABLE workbench_turns (
                    id text primary key,
                    task_id text not null,
                    client_request_id text not null unique,
                    task_sequence integer not null check(task_sequence > 0),
                    user_text text not null,
                    status text not null check(status in (
                        'queued', 'running', 'waiting_confirmation',
                        'completed', 'stopped', 'failed'
                    )),
                    stop_requested integer not null default 0
                        check(stop_requested in (0, 1)),
                    final_text text not null default '',
                    error_code text not null default '',
                    error_detail text not null default '',
                    resume_context text not null default '',
                    lease_owner text not null default '',
                    lease_expires_at text not null default '',
                    execution_run_id text not null default '',
                    runtime_quiesced_run_id text not null default '',
                    started_at text not null default '',
                    completed_at text not null default '',
                    created_at text not null default current_timestamp,
                    updated_at text not null default current_timestamp,
                    foreign key(task_id) references workbench_tasks(id)
                )
CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_events_id_turn_id on workbench_events(id, turn_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_events_turn_id_id on workbench_events(turn_id, id)

CREATE TABLE workbench_events (
                    id integer primary key autoincrement,
                    turn_id text not null,
                    sequence integer not null,
                    event_type text not null,
                    payload_json text not null,
                    created_at text not null default current_timestamp,
                    unique(turn_id, sequence),
                    foreign key(turn_id) references workbench_turns(id)
                )
CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_attachments_task_created_id on workbench_attachments(task_id, created_at, id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_workbench_attachments_task_request on workbench_attachments(task_id, client_request_id)

CREATE TABLE workbench_attachments (
                    id text primary key,

                )
CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_artifacts_created_id_turn on workbench_artifacts(created_at, id, turn_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_artifacts_turn_created_id on workbench_artifacts(turn_id, created_at, id)

CREATE TABLE workbench_artifacts (

                    turn_id text not null,
                    label text not null,
                    path text not null,
                    media_type text not null,
                    created_at text not null default current_timestamp,
                    foreign key(turn_id) references workbench_turns(id)
                )

                on workbench_confirmations(id)

CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_confirmations_recovery
                on workbench_confirmations(execution_lease_expires_at, id)
                where status='confirmed' and result_json=''
                  and execution_owner<>'' and execution_lease_expires_at<>''
CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_confirmations_turn_created_id on workbench_confirmations(turn_id, created_at, id)
CREATE INDEX idx_workbench_confirmations_turn_status on workbench_confirmations(turn_id, status, result_json, created_at, id)

CREATE TABLE workbench_confirmations (
                    id text primary key,
                    turn_id text not null,
                    action_kind text not null,
                    target text not null,
                    summary text not null,
                    risk text not null,
                    canonical_capability text not null default '',
                    canonical_operation text not null default '',
                    canonical_targets_json text not null default '[]',
                    canonical_operation_digest text not null default '',
                    canonical_arguments_digest text not null default '',
                    arguments_json text not null,
                    status text not null check(status in (
                        'pending', 'confirmed', 'cancelled', 'executed', 'failed'
                    )),
                    result_json text not null default '',
                    created_at text not null default current_timestamp,
                    decided_at text not null default '',
                    execution_owner text not null default '',
                    execution_lease_expires_at text not null default '',
                    execution_started_at text not null default '',
                    authorization_consumed_at text not null default '',
                    proposer_run_id text not null default '',
                    proposer_owner text not null default '',
                    proposer_lease_expires_at text not null default '',
                    proposer_quiesced_at text not null default '',
                    decision_requested text not null default ''

                    decision_requested_at text not null default '',
                    foreign key(turn_id) references workbench_turns(id)
                )

CREATE TABLE scheduled_tasks (
                    id integer primary key autoincrement,
                    migration_key text,
                    name text not null,
                    prompt text not null,
                    cron_expression text not null,
                    timezone text not null,
                    runtime_id text not null,
                    runtime_options_json text not null default '{}',

                    created_at text not null default current_timestamp,

    )
